# Blackline 0.15.121

* The line under a name in a conversation no longer says Offline or Reachable — the dot on their picture and the link icon already do. What is left there is only what a name cannot say: a build too old to talk to yours, or how many people are in a group.
* Which device, direct or relayed, and the round trip are on the link icon beside the name (hover it).
